show_reading_progress.label: Article: show the reading progress bar
show_reading_progress.description: Shows a thin bar across the top of the page that fills as the reader scrolls down a story.

fable_article_breadcrumb.label: Article: show the breadcrumb
fable_article_breadcrumb.description: Shows the trail of links (Home, section, story) above the headline.

fable_article_kicker.label: Article: show the section name above the headline
fable_article_kicker.description: Shows the story's section above the headline when the breadcrumb is not shown.

fable_article_standfirst.label: Article: show the standfirst under the headline
fable_article_standfirst.description: Shows the short summary (excerpt) under the headline when the story has one.

fable_byline_avatar.label: Article byline: show the author's initials
fable_byline_avatar.description: Shows a circle with the lead author's initials beside the byline.

fable_byline_authors.label: Article byline: show the author names
fable_byline_authors.description: Shows "By" and the names of the story's authors in the byline.

fable_byline_date.label: Article byline: show the publication date
fable_byline_date.description: Shows the date the story was published in the byline.

fable_article_show_updated.label: Article byline: show the Updated date
fable_article_show_updated.description: Shows the date a story was updated, after the publication date, when it was changed after publishing.

show_reading_time.label: Article byline: show the reading time
show_reading_time.description: Shows how many minutes a story takes to read, such as "5 min read".

show_updated_date.label: Article byline: show Updated for edited stories
show_updated_date.description: Lets a story show an Updated date once it was edited after it was published; turn it off to never show one.

updated_after_days.label: Article byline: days before an edit counts as Updated
updated_after_days.description: A story shows an Updated date only when it was edited at least this many days after it was published.

fable_article_hero.label: Article hero: show the large picture
fable_article_hero.description: Shows the story's featured picture, large, under the byline.

fable_article_hero_caption.label: Article hero: show the caption and credit
fable_article_hero_caption.description: Shows the picture's caption and credit under the large picture.

fable_article_fields_before.label: Article: show custom fields before the text
fable_article_fields_before.description: Shows the custom fields you set to appear before the story's text, such as a "Reviewed by" line.

fable_article_fields_after.label: Article: show custom fields after the text
fable_article_fields_after.description: Shows the custom fields you set to appear after the story's text.

show_contents.label: Article: show the In this story list
show_contents.description: Shows a list of the story's headings in the side rail so readers can jump to a part (stories and pages).

article_lede.label: Article: set the first paragraph larger
article_lede.description: Sets the first paragraph of a story in larger type, as an introduction.

fable_article_inline_related.label: Article: show a Related card inside the text
fable_article_inline_related.description: Shows one related story as a small card inside the text, after its second paragraph.

fable_article_after_content.label: Article: show the area under the text
fable_article_after_content.description: Shows the After content area, where you can place a callout, a button or featured posts, under the story.

fable_article_ad_leaderboard.label: Article ads: show the top banner
fable_article_ad_leaderboard.description: Shows the wide ad area above the story (the ad-leaderboard region), while ads are on.

fable_article_ad_in_article.label: Article ads: show the ad inside the text
fable_article_ad_in_article.description: Shows the ad area inside the story's text (the ad-in-article region), while ads are on.

fable_article_ad_second.label: Article ads: show the ad after the text
fable_article_ad_second.description: Shows the second ad area after the story's text (the ad-in-article-2 region), while ads are on.

fable_article_ad_half_page.label: Article ads: show the tall ad beside the story
fable_article_ad_half_page.description: Shows the tall ad area beside the story on screens 1440 pixels wide and up (the ad-half-page region), while ads are on.

show_read_next.label: Article read next: show the Read next strip
show_read_next.description: Shows one related story as a Read next strip after the text.

fable_read_next_reason.label: Article read next: show the reason line
fable_read_next_reason.description: Shows the small line under the Read next headline that says why the story is suggested.

show_tags.label: Article: show the tags under the story
show_tags.description: Shows the "Filed under" tags below a story.

show_author_card.label: Article author card: show the author card
show_author_card.description: Shows a box about each author below the story, when they have a bio or a page.

fable_author_card_avatar.label: Article author card: show the initials
fable_author_card_avatar.description: Shows a circle with the author's initials in the author card.

fable_author_card_bio.label: Article author card: show the bio
fable_author_card_bio.description: Shows the author's bio in the author card.

fable_author_card_link.label: Article author card: show the More from link
fable_author_card_link.description: Shows the "More from ..." link to the author's page in the author card.

show_related.label: Article related: show the Keep reading row
show_related.description: Shows a row of related stories under the article.

fable_related_more_link.label: Article related: show the All section link
fable_related_more_link.description: Shows the link to the story's whole section at the right of the row's heading.

show_comments.label: Comments: show comments on stories
show_comments.description: Shows the comments and the comment form under stories; turn it off to hide them everywhere.

fable_comments_avatar.label: Comments: show the initials circle
fable_comments_avatar.description: Shows a circle with the writer's initials beside each comment.

fable_comments_author_badge.label: Comments: show the Author badge
fable_comments_author_badge.description: Shows an Author badge on a comment written by one of the story's authors.

fable_page_breadcrumb.label: Page: show the breadcrumb
fable_page_breadcrumb.description: Shows the trail of links above a page's title.

fable_page_standfirst.label: Page: show the standfirst under the title
fable_page_standfirst.description: Shows the page's short summary under its title when it has one.

show_updated.label: Page: show the Last updated line
show_updated.description: Shows when the page was last updated, under its title.

fable_page_hero.label: Page: show the featured picture
fable_page_hero.description: Shows the page's featured picture under its title.

fable_page_fields.label: Page: show custom fields
fable_page_fields.description: Shows the custom fields you set to appear on a page.

page_lede.label: Page: set the first paragraph larger
page_lede.description: Sets the first paragraph of a page in larger type, as an introduction.

show_children.label: Page: show the pages under this one
show_children.description: Shows a list of the pages that sit under this page.

show_page_comments.label: Page: show comments
show_page_comments.description: Shows comments under a page, when the page has a comment thread.
